name: codex-worker-delegation
description: Codex-native delegation and verified multi-provider coexistence for ChatGPT Linux.

interface.longDescription: Control per-role provider/model routing from a local Web panel while preserving official ChatGPT authentication. Built-in OpenAI routes may use native subagents; third-party routes use explicit App Server threads to avoid current custom-provider subagent transport defects.
defaultPrompt: Use native subagents only for built-in OpenAI routes. Use delegate_worker for every route involving a third-party provider.
